title: Boot-recovery concurrency test bets a real 250 ms per-operation deadline on scheduling, so a loaded full gate fails one target
outcome: tests::engram_host_adapter::boot_recovery_bounds_worker_concurrency_across_many_targets asserts batch ownership and concurrency, and its result no longer depends on how fast the machine schedules workers.
acceptance: No timeout is raised as the fix, and production deadlines and defaults are unchanged.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

The test's pass or fail no longer depends on wall-clock scheduling. A test that holds a worker past the former 250 ms per-operation deadline before it reaches the transport still sees all 26 status-plus-bind requests and the bounded concurrency. Expiry behavior stays covered by its own budget test, unchanged.

completion.summary: The boot-recovery concurrency test no longer depends on how fast workers are scheduled. Its 250 ms per-operation and batch budgets run on the shared scripted EngramBudgetClock, a worker held 300 real ms still yields all 26 status-plus-bind requests with concurrency 8, and a separate logical-expiry witness keeps deadline_exceeded covered. Production deadlines and defaults are unchanged. Landed in train 18 as 7f10cfb (merge 75718d3, landing 5c6f6dd). Full gate test-3cd1a029 passed on master f7a26a5 and was credited (4631710a).
